mines.mine_notes: Fully integrated underground gold operation, ~35 km east of Marathon, northwestern Ontario (Trans-Canada Highway, north of Lake Superior). Consolidated property >45,000 ha bringing together historic David Bell, Golden Giant and Williams Lake claims; ~25 Moz gold produced since 1985. Infrastructure: 10,000 tpd mill; underground complex via shaft + ramp (6,000 tpd hoisting + ramp haulage). 'More than a decade of reserves' per company; updated mineral reserve/resource estimate expected H2 2026. Post-acquisition (Nov 26-Dec 31, 2025): 16,503 oz attributable at 4.71 g/t, 93.2% recovery; no 2025 sales (production sold early 2026). Full-year mine production (incl. pre-acquisition under Barrick): 120,841 oz, in line with Barrick guidance. 2026 initiatives: phased production ramp-up, transition to owner-operator, new mobile equipment, mining sequence changes, reserve/resource optimization, ERP implementation. Franco-Nevada holds 50% NPI on Interlake claim. Gold-price-linked contingent consideration to Barrick. Attributable ounces presented net of the Franco-Nevada NPI.

notes: Formerly Carcetti Capital Corp.; acquired the Hemlo Gold Mine from certain wholly-owned subsidiaries of Barrick Mining Corporation on Nov 26, 2025 for total consideration with a fair value of US$1.0B (up to US$1.09B announced deal value). Began trading as Hemlo Mining Corp. (TSX-V:HMMC) Dec 2, 2025. FY2025: cash US$132.0M at Dec 31, 2025; net loss US$36.9M (US$36.2M in Q4), primarily acquisition transaction costs; operating cash outflow US$24.6M. Acquisition financing ~US$1.1B: US$300M Precious Metals Purchase Agreement (stream) with Wheaton Precious Metals, US$250M secured credit agreement, US$538.3M gross proceeds from subscription-receipt private placement. Mar 2026: repaid US$75M drawn on revolving credit facility (balance nil). CEO Jason Kosec. All amounts in USD.
